title: SynapseColabBenchmarkDatasetRegistry
description: Standardized registry of industry benchmark datasets for Synapse evaluation on Google Colab and cloud instances (RFC 0063 compliant).

starter_dev.name: Starter Development Set
starter_dev.description: Lightweight, zero-GPU starter set for quick local verification, CI smoke tests, and basic algorithm gate assertions.

standard_eval.name: Standard Benchmark Evaluation Set
standard_eval.description: Comprehensive statistical evaluation set with 100+ assets for rigorous Track-A/Track-B quality gate validation.

full_industrial.name: Full Industrial Comparison Suite
full_industrial.description: Full datasets including multi-model neural evaluators (VBench, ChronoMagic, full Objaverse-LVIS test split).

datasets.name: Google Scanned Objects (20 Golden Assets)
datasets.description: 20 representative watertight scanned objects (furniture, tools, toys) with physical metric ground truth.

datasets.name: Google Scanned Objects (100 Benchmark Assets)
datasets.description: Industry-standard 100-asset evaluation split for direct comparison with Microsoft TRELLIS and Tencent Hunyuan3D-2.0.

datasets.name: Objaverse-LVIS Starter Submesh (10 Clean GLBs)
datasets.description: 10 curated manifold GLB meshes with diverse topologies for rapid non-manifold and watertightness testing.

datasets.name: Objaverse-LVIS Benchmark Split (100 Evaluated Assets)
datasets.description: 100 official test split assets from CVPR 2023 Objaverse-LVIS benchmark.

datasets.name: Mixamo Humanoid Kinematics Starter (5 Core Motions)
datasets.description: 5 canonical rigged motions (Idle, Walk Frontal, Run 180, Jump Down, Turn Left) with zero-slip contact ground truth.

datasets.name: VBench Official Prompt & Trajectory Suite (CVPR 2024)
datasets.description: 16 evaluation dimensions with 2,000+ standardized prompts for temporal consistency, camera motion, and object coherence.

datasets.name: VBench Auxiliary Neural Evaluator Weights
datasets.description: ViCLIP, RAFT optical flow, and DINOv2 feature extractor weights for automated video quality scoring.

datasets.name: ChronoMagic-Bench Physical Causality Core (50 Cases)
datasets.description: 50 high-frame-rate physical video scenarios testing gravity, collisions, and liquid time-arrow irreversibility.

datasets.name: Human3.6M Large-Scale 3D Human Pose & Mocap Dataset (HuggingFace Mirror)
datasets.description: World-standard Human3.6M 3D pose and motion dataset (S1, S5, S6, S7, S8, S9, S11) for foot-sliding and bone-drift evaluation.
